name: real backend only: shopper asks about an order
context: The shopper is on the orders page.

simulate.persona: You are a shopper who ordered hiking boots and is impatient. Your order number is A-1042. You answer briefly and only give the order number when asked.
simulate.goal: Find out whether your order has shipped.

success: The agent looked the order up with get_order_status and told the user it has shipped, without inventing a delivery date that the tool did not return.
